info.title: COURTSIDE API
info.description: Milestone 3: Six CRUD entities, business rules, OpenAPI documentation, and MapLark sports halls/arenas discovery (plus legacy court discovery). JWT authentication and role permissions are Milestone 4 tasks; all M3 CRUD endpoints are currently unprotected. The other SPA screens still display demo data. MapLark is attempted first; if unavailable, the backend uses the Overpass OpenStreetMap API. The response provider field reports the actual source.

get.summary: Discover mapped basketball courts from OpenStreetMap (MapLark/Overpass)
get.description: Proxies MapLark OpenStreetMap Features v3; only server reads the API key. Results displayed on Find courts. Locations are approximate for polygon features and not verified on site. If MapLark denies access or is unavailable, the backend automatically tries Overpass; the provider field reports MapLark or Overpass. Neither service guarantees the named facilities or confirms opening hours. Provider policy: MapLark is tried first for category discovery; when unavailable, the backend tries keyless OpenStreetMap Photon and then Overpass. Returns a provider field identifying the actual source. The public demo endpoints offer no uptime guarantee.

get.summary: Discover basketball courts and potential indoor basketball halls near a city or neighbourhood
get.description: Only basketball-tagged outdoor pitches and potentially basketball-capable indoor sports halls/centres are returned. Explicitly non-basketball venues and unrelated businesses are excluded. Optional area=Grbavica resolves a neighbourhood, then discovers facilities near it even when the venue has a different name. Use name=Goran Čengić to search for a specific venue by name. An unknown indoor hall is labelled possible; explicit basketball tagging is labelled confirmed as an OSM tag, not verified access. MapLark is tried for city-wide categories, followed by Photon and Overpass; neighbourhood and named search use Photon. Data may be incomplete and does not confirm availability or permission to play.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Optional venue name (e.g. Goran Čengić); strictly filtered to sports categories.

parameters.name: area
parameters.description: Optional neighbourhood around the selected city (e.g. Grbavica); venues need not contain the neighbourhood text in their names.

200.description: Mapped basketball courts and potential indoor sports halls; basketball accessibility not verified

404.description: Neighbourhood not found in the selected city
